title: Phone Slip: Marlow Coast Radio 1 — "Which Magnitude?" + Parents' Post

fields.fromOrg: Marlow Coast Radio 1 (on generator, still on air)
fields.message: Has 3 numbers: phone alert 7.3, tsunami warning 8.0, someone read him a USGS update 8.7. Which one does he put on air? Also: how big is the wave? Listeners asking if it's 30 ft. ALSO: parent forwarded FB screenshot, Port Alder Elementary Parents group, Jenna R. 10:28: "Cell barely working. I'm driving down Front Street to get my kids out of the school NOW, they can't walk that far." 34 comments, several say "on my way."

instructorNote: This pressure inject checks message discipline. The PIO should confirm one labeled magnitude with the Warning Coordinator (latest version, with source and issue time, and a note that it will change), give no wave height because nothing has been observed, and send the same message on radio, Facebook and every other working channel: the students are already walking to Spruce Hill, parents must not drive into the zone, reunification is at Marlow Coast High School, and more waves will follow. Watch for a PIO who reads all three magnitudes on air, guesses at a wave height, or deals with the radio station and doesn't answer the parents' post.
